title: UK population pyramid interactive
meta_description: Use our interactive population pyramid to find out more about how the demographics of your local area compare with others across the country.
lede: Use our interactive population pyramid to find out more about how the demographics of your local area compare with others across the country.

body.box_text:
19 May 2026

Please note that this page is based on the 2016-based national population projections and is no longer updated. The new [UK Population Projection Explorer](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationprojections/articles/ukpopulationprojectionexplorer/2025-01-28) was launched in 2025 and has been updated to include the latest 2024-based national population projections data.

For local authorities in England, interactive population pyramids are available in our latest [Subnational population projections for England: 2022-based bulletin](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationprojections/bulletins/subnationalpopulationprojectionsforengland/2022based).

20 March 2025

This population pyramid is not working correctly for some local authority areas and includes population data that have since been revised. Please see our [Population estimates](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationestimates) and [Population projections](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationprojections#publications) pages for the most recent data.

body.text: The demography of the UK is changing as people are living longer, but the age and sex structure of local areas can differ greatly depending on where you are. Have a look at how your area compares with others, or the whole of the UK.

To use the tool, pick areas of interest and choose the year using the slider at the bottom. You can also see how the population has changed over time, and how it is projected to change in the next 20 years, by pressing the play button.

Data for 1998, 2008, and 2018 are based on population estimates from mid-2018. Data for 2028 and 2038 are based on projections from mid-2016. The 2028 and 2038 values for Welsh local authorities are based on projections from mid-2014.

Newer country-level projections are available in our [2018-based national population projections](https://www.ons.gov.uk/peoplepopulationandcommunity/populationandmigration/populationprojections/bulletins/nationalpopulationprojections/2018based).
